tools.name: search_company_knowledge
tools.description: Search this business's knowledge base (uploaded documents, FAQs, policies, pricing, service descriptions) for information relevant to the customer's question. Always use this before answering any question about the business's specific policies, prices, services, or procedures. Never answer those from general knowledge — only from what this tool returns. If the tool returns no relevant results, say you don't have that information and offer to connect the customer with a human, rather than guessing.

query.description: A focused search query capturing what the customer wants to know. Rephrase their question into a clear, standalone query — don't just copy their raw message if it's vague or conversational.

notes: This is the ONLY tool wired up in Phase 2. The full tool list from the architecture doc (create_lead, book_appointment, etc.) gets added incrementally in later phases — adding them all now, before n8n can actually validate/execute them, would let Claude 'succeed' at proposing actions nothing can carry out.

input_schema follows the Claude Messages API tool-use format exactly: https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/tool-use — verify against current docs before adding more tools, in case the schema shape has changed.
n8n never trusts this tool call blindly: it re-validates that search_company_knowledge is a real, enabled tool for this tenant before executing (see workflow spec).
